The Owls, led by second year head coach [[Michael Curry (basketball)|Michael Curry]], played their home games at the [[FAU Arena]], and were members of [[Conference USA]]. They finished the season 8–25, 5–13 in [[2015–16 Conference USA men's basketball season|C-USA play]] to finish in a tie for 12th place. They defeated [[2015–16 UTSA Roadrunners men's basketball team|UTSA]] in the first round of the [[2016 Conference USA men's basketball tournament|C-USA tournament]] to advance to the second round where they lost to [[2015–16 Old Dominion Monarchs basketball team|Old Dominion]]. == Previous season == The [[2014–15 Florida Atlantic Owls men's basketball team|Owls]] finished the [[2014–15 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2014–15 season]] 9–20, 2–16 in [[2014–15 Conference USA men's basketball season|C-USA play]] to finish in last place.
